title.narrative: Private sector transition to a green and circular economy in Lebanon

description.narrative: The Overall Objective of the contract is to support the transition of the private sector to achieve a green and circular economic recovery within the food and beverage sector. title.narrative: Production Efficiency: increased resource productivity and reduced operational costs of the businesses

description.narrative: The indicator can be expressed through 2 metrics: the first will reflect the accumulated reduction of operational costs of the businesses that will adopt TEST/RECP strategies and practices, which is measured through the baseline and target detailed below. The second is the relationship of this cost saving with the total cost of inputs as a proxy of an improved productive efficiency, expressed as a percentage. Hence, for the latter, and average of 2 % of increased resource productivity (cost saving/total cost of inputs) will be targeted and will be reported in the annual reports.

title.narrative: No. of firms with economic gains.

description.narrative: The indicator will report firms with economic gains, such as increased sales and/or savings, as a proxy for increased value addition. The project will promote that at least 25 % of the benefited companies will be womenled enterprises, meaning they have women in managerial positions relevant for the TEST projects.

comment.narrative: The earlier work carried out by UNIDO for SMEs in Lebanon has already assisted industries in strengthening economic gains and hence a baseline has already been indicated considering the number of companies reported by the time of the LF definition.
20 more companies will be added to the set of successful cases with economic gains thanks to the application of resource efficiency and TEST.
